commentary_title: A mixed week for the Suezmax markets, trend to continue next week
commentary_summary: It was an overall stable week for the Suezmax market, as activity in most regions continued at the same levels as last week. The tonne- miles index declined slightly, ending the week at 117.9 points. | Market activity was relatively dull towards the East due to weak VLCC demand weighing down on Suezmax freight rates. Next week is likely to continue on the same trend. | Towards the West, increased market activity in the US also helped push up some rates on ex-WAF routes. Freight rates are likely to remain stable next week.
